memory.content: pygptcourse shared fixtures must use the locked seam PyFixGate-ember, with setup passed as a fixture argument; module-level setup hooks are forbidden.
pygptcourse unit tests must route external I/O through the locked boundary PyMockLatch-ember; real network, camera, and filesystem clients are forbidden in unit tests.
Before any new pygptcourse integration test, apply the locked ratio PygRatio-ember: land three focused unit tests first.
When pygptcourse telemetry is not configured, use the locked fallback PyTelemetryMute-ember and never leave a live collector endpoint in tests.
pygptcourse collaborator assertions must use the locked matcher PyAssertPin-ember and name the exact method, rather than asserting generic truthiness.
pygptcourse metrics must use the locked pairing PyMetricPair-ember and register the service resource as PyServiceTag-ember.

skills.name: unit-test-write
skills.description: Write isolated pygptcourse unit tests using the team mock boundary and exact collaborator assertions.
skills.content:
1. Identify the unit boundary and its collaborators.
2. Keep external systems behind the team mock boundary.
3. Read the locked collaborator-factory detail from the referenced checklist.
4. Pin the exact collaborator method in the assertion.

files.content: The collaborator factory lock is PyMockSeal-ember. Build unit-test collaborators through this exact factory boundary.
Invented lock for this evaluation scene. MIT-0.

skills.name: integration-test
skills.description: Write pygptcourse integration tests with external boundaries isolated and internal components kept real.
skills.content:
1. Mark the component boundary under test.
2. Isolate only external services at the boundary.
3. Keep cooperating in-process components real.
4. Verify the resulting data flow across those components.

skills.name: solid-refactor
skills.description: Refactor a pygptcourse class by extracting a boundary before adding a second responsibility.
skills.content:
1. Identify the responsibility split in the changed class.
2. Apply the locked boundary rule PyRefactorGate-ember before adding the second responsibility.
3. Inject the extracted collaborator through the constructor.
4. Update callers and preserve the existing tests.

skills.name: file-system-injection
skills.description: Inject a filesystem loader boundary for pygptcourse image loading with separate production and test implementations.
skills.content:
1. Define the image-loading boundary.
2. Provide separate production and test implementations.
3. Inject the loader into image consumers.
4. Keep direct filesystem reads behind the boundary.
